evidence: Traced all 16 functional criteria in listed order plus gates, polish and visual against the seed and every earlier write. Order: test.sh runs gates suite then scored suite with --max-concurrent-agent 1 (test.sh:203-226); rewardkit holds the agent semaphore per whole dimension (reward.py _guarded) and individual mode runs criteria sequentially (judges.py _arun_agent_individual), so functional criteria run in listed order before polish/visual. State-relative wording is explicit: functional prompt.md:53 'Criteria share one database; never write something a later criterion does not expect' and :78-82 'judge it against the state the earlier ones left'; polish prompt.md:34 and visual prompt.md:49 'do not assume the seed state'/'after the functional writes'; app_context.md:30. Each criterion creates its own unique JUDGE-* probes and checks only them or seeded facts no earlier criterion touches: K-17 'Insurer letter' is released only in hold_scope_and_release; K-13/K-18 are consumed only in timer_changes (M-13 restored to 30 days, step 4); Sian's M-12 wall is lifted in wall_added_live step 4 and no later step uses Sian in M-12; persistence's M-11 wall/M-12 timer are last and cleaned up, and polish/visual never use them. Later readbacks are relative: unread step 4 'at least 2', unread step 1 counts deltas after Dev reads M-13, persistence notes Dev's count/'Probate'/'Insurer letter'/'Survey booked' before restart and compares after; visual matter_sidebar excuses absent counts; retention_marks says 'a thread such as M-13' so M-11's untouched 7-day notice works if M-13's timer were left off. Every seeded message later criteria depend on (K-3, K-8, K-11, K-2, K-16, K-7 held) survives any timer a partial earlier run could leave, since M-11's timer is never changed and M-13 only goes to 7/off/30 with K-8 two days old. Search probes ('JUDGE-O', '100%', 'A_1', 'X*9', 'notice recieved', 'heads of terms ... from M-12') are not matched by earlier writes. Runtime: the scripted golden sequence (qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/results/golden-run.log, hash-verified, source hashes equal the frozen solution) ran gate_constraints, all 16 functional criteria in order on one DB including current tokens JUDGE-CS2/W3/TE/LV/Q5, a real restart, then the six polish criteria: all PASS. Residual risk (not a cross-dimension defect): no full configured judge run on these bytes (index scope says absent); and rewardkit 0.1.7 re-runs a whole agent session on schema mismatch (judges.py:530-567), so a re-run of timer_changes or hold_scope_and_release would find K-13/K-18 or K-17's hold already consumed and fail its own positive controls; the '-2' rule (functional prompt.md:34-35) covers repeated posts but not consumed seed state. Phone transcript (polish transcript_phone) will include functional-posted message links, which is legitimate product state under conversations.md:35.
